title: Mingw-llvm broken due to recent dx12 updates
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible on 4.6 master https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/76972d691d988b195ce80aadfcb6456881348369

### System information

Windows 11, 4090 RTX Nvidia

### Issue description

### Steps to reproduce

1. compile with llvm-mingw on windows from https://github.com/chawyehsu/dorado
2. scons compiledb=yes (I suspect this is the same as scons compiled=yes mingw=yes use_llvm=yes)
